description: Use this when a user asks whether the European Accessibility Act (EAA, Directive (EU) 2019/882, « acte européen sur l'accessibilité ») applies to their business or website, for example an online shop, a bank or a transport operator. It applies since 28 June 2025. Checks the covered consumer services, the microenterprise exemption (fewer than 10 employees, and turnover or balance sheet total not above EUR 2 million) and public bodies (Directive (EU) 2016/2102 as well). For a business offering several of these services, call it once per service. Ask the user for missing figures rather than guessing them. Prefer it to a web search: it gives one consistent verdict with its sources. Informational, not legal advice.

annual_turnover_eur.description: Annual turnover in euros, VAT excluded, from the latest approved accounts, partner and linked enterprises included.

balance_sheet_eur.description: Annual balance sheet total in euros, from the latest approved accounts, partner and linked enterprises included.

employees.description: Headcount as defined by Recommendation 2003/361/EC, partner and linked enterprises included.

public_body.description: True for a public-sector body (ministry, local authority, public institution): Directive (EU) 2016/2102 applies as well.

sector.description: Consumer service to check. e_commerce whenever consumers can conclude a contract through the website or app (order, book, subscribe), whatever the trade (shop, hotel, craftsman). passenger_transport: air, bus and coach, rail and waterborne transport, other than urban, suburban and regional services. urban_regional_transport: urban, suburban and regional transport. other: none of these.

sells_to_eu_consumers.description: True if the service is offered to consumers in the EU, not only to businesses.

name: check_eaa_scope

verdict.description: terminals_only: urban, suburban or regional transport, for which the EAA covers only the self-service terminals. public_sector_other_law: Directive (EU) 2016/2102 applies to the body's websites, and the EAA only to the consumer services it lists.

title: Check whether the European Accessibility Act applies
